title: Task: bring a compose stack up

room.title: Task: bring a compose stack up
room.summary: Point the website at the payment service.

setup.content:
services:
  nginx:
    image: nginx:alpine
    ports:
      - "8080:80"
    depends_on:
      - website
  website:
    image: byterig-web:1.0
    environment:
      - PAYMENT_URL=http://localhost:9999
    depends_on:
      - payment
  payment:
    image: byterig-pay:1.0
    environment:
      - PAYMENT_MODE=live
    ports:
      - "4002:4002"

rule.description: Fix docker-compose.yml and bring the stack up healthy
